method: First-order propagation in log(depth), then exp(log(depth) ± 3 sigma_log_depth)
interpretation: Approximate central 99.73% interval only under the assumed independent lognormal inputs and local log-linear response. Not measured scatter, a confidence interval, a worst-case bound or a validated Mars prediction.
scope: Conditional on the x-axis downward speed, selected obliquity and Poncelet model. Trajectory, model discrepancy, layering, shape change, fracture and survival uncertainty are excluded. A zero inertial coefficient remains exactly zero.
